nodes.label: Diyorbek Komilov Portfolio
nodes.rationale: Personal portfolio website built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion and React Router.

nodes.label: Portfolio Content Lives In projects.ts
nodes.rationale: Project and case study content is managed in src/content/projects.ts rather than hardcoded into components, so adding a case study is a data edit.

nodes.label: Hero Music Player Static Assets
nodes.rationale: Static assets used by the hero music player live under public/audio and public/images/covers.

nodes.label: Component Structure Convention
nodes.rationale: src/components holds page sections and shared UI composition; src/components/ui holds shadcn/ui primitives and custom UI components; src/pages holds route-level pages; src/content holds structured content.
